Senses.Explanation: A compact poetic image of an arrow piercing the red sun's image; the retained records deploy it without fixing a single allegorical explanation. Gulin Qingmao uses the expression through master-authored verse deployment. Pinjixiang Zhixiang independently deploys it through independent direct hall deployment.
